423404.overview:
A handheld from Tandy. You are able to switch between Football, Soccer, and Basketball via interchangeable face plates. 

-3 separate, easy-to-change playing field inserts
-Exciting 2-player action in 3 games
-2 skill levels on each game
-LED scoreboard display
-Pass and Shoot plus Angle Pass and Shoot controls

423442.overview:
A 4-in-1 Prinztronic handheld that includes a calculator and 3 games; Speedway, Brain Drain, and Blackjack. 

Not much information out there about this. It shares resemblance with other handhelds from Videomaster, Vtech and RadioShack.

464680.overview: A dedicated handheld electronic simple LED and button game that lets you play baseball, with another player taking turns to pitch and bat, or play against the CPU, it also features a practice mode.
